scientific_integrity: An exact symbolic-certificate proof and reproducible rational computations establish the stated discrete-time model claims; no field-data validation or independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The sharp cusp classifies synchronous equilibria, not all asynchronous equilibria for general mixing. All-positive fixed-point classification and exponential synchronization are established at the exact rational parameters. Persistence under perturbations is local. The phenomenological survival profile is not calibrated to a species.
title: A sharp cusp for dual persistent carrying capacities under density-dependent dispersal
